description: Show the Add to CRM account this connection belongs to: which CRM is connected, how many lookup credits are left, and anything that will currently stop a lookup or an add.
name: get_account

credits.description: lookup credits available; one is spent for each work e-mail address found

credits_shared.description: true when the lookup credits are one balance shared by the customer's whole team, so credits is the team's and not only the customer's own

crm.description: the connected CRM; absent when none is connected

needs_reconnect.description: true when the saved connection to the CRM no longer works and the customer must reconnect it in Add to CRM

email_verified.description: whether the customer has confirmed their e-mail address

no_crm_mode.description: true when the customer works without a CRM, saving people to lists instead

restrictions.description: stable codes for anything that will refuse right now: account_inactive, email_not_verified, no_credits, no_crm_connected, crm_needs_reconnect

title: Get account
